Floppy little fighters on a floating arena. Punch, grab and throw everyone else off the edge. Last one standing takes the round; first to 3 rounds wins.

Player 1

  • Move W A S D
  • Jump Space
  • Punch F
  • Grab (hold) G

Player 2

  • Move Arrows
  • Jump / or Num 0
  • Punch , or K
  • Grab (hold) . or L

Hold grab on someone, then punch to throw them. Falling? Hold grab to catch a ledge, then jump to climb up. Enough hits knock a brawler out cold for a moment. In Solo and Wi‑Fi games, Player 2's keys work too. Esc returns here.

Drag the left pad to move. Hold Grab on someone, then tap Punch to throw them. Hold Grab while falling to catch a ledge, then Jump to climb. Two-player modes need a keyboard.

Wi‑Fi party

Put every device on the same Wi‑Fi network or phone hotspot and open this game on each one. One device hosts and runs the match; the others join by swapping a code with the host.

Keep the host's screen on and this page in front while you play. Devices talk to each other directly over the local network, so the match itself doesn't need internet.

Invite players one at a time: they scan your invite, then you scan their reply.

Point the camera at the code
